run_cudagraphify: run cudagraphify to wrap a PyTorch model into a CUDA graph for efficient replay on GPU
reset_cudagraph_trees: reset cudagraph trees to clear all recorded graphs and free associated memory pools
mark_step_begin: mark step begin to signal a new training or inference iteration for CUDA graph generation tracking
check_memory_pool: check memory pool to verify live CUDA graph allocations match expected tensor outputs
clear_cublass_cache: clear cublas cache to prevent persistent workspace allocations from corrupting CUDA graph memory pools
